native_parameter_contract.button_array: records have signed 16-bit left/top/right/bottom at offsets 0/2/4/6 and 28-byte native stride

native_behavior: Scan from index zero and stop at the first matching button.
Bounds are left/top inclusive and right/bottom exclusive.
Each signed 16-bit bound is sign-extended and added to its signed 32-bit origin with x86 32-bit wrap before signed comparison.
On a hit, write cursor Y then cursor X into the two hit-coordinate globals and return index plus one.
On no hit, return zero and leave the hit-coordinate globals unchanged.

project_search.decision: Reconstructed from REA rather than reusing the legacy body because it reads/writes absolute globals through I(address).

implementation.logical_rectangles: Uses PharaohMenuRect records; the C representation does not retain the native 28-byte record stride because only the four named geometry fields are consumed.

limitations: No behavior test or game process was run.
The helper is not yet called by a clean menu input dispatcher.
